name: witcher-hud
description: Witcher 3 style HUD for Claude Code

plugins.name: witcher-hud
plugins.description: A Witcher 3 style HUD for Claude Code: a medallion that casts a sign for each tool, vitality for the context left, stamina for the rate limit, adrenaline for clean tool streaks, crowns for cost and a quest tracker; moments, effects and sounds for quests, level ups, monsters, trophies and meditation; and a career kept across sessions, with levels, a bestiary, trophies and a journal pane
